model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the values of Saldo (rechte Skala), Exporte (linke Skala), and Importe (linke Skala) over time. The x-axis represents the year from 2021 to 2023, with a linear scale and tick labels spaced every one year. The y-axis, labeled in Mrd. US-Dollar, ranges from -200 to 400, with tick intervals of 50 units. The blue line represents Saldo (rechte Skala), starting at approximately 100 in 2021 and reaching a peak of approximately 300 in 2023, with a value of approximately 250 at the end of the x-axis. The red line represents Exporte (linke Skala), beginning at approximately 10 in 2021 and rising to approximately 300 in 2023, with a value of approximately 200 at the end of the x-axis. The black line represents Importe (linke Skala), starting at approximately -200 in 2021 and remaining relatively constant at approximately -100 throughout the x-axis. The gray line represents a series of bars, with values ranging from -200 to 20, and spaced every 50 units.
